articles.hausa_translation: Gaida: Gidaje na CAF: Kwatsire na gida a ƙarshe sun kawo da Rangers, El-Kanemi cikin gida. Are there any financial or administrative irregularities in these matches, or is this framed solely as sports performance?

articles.title: The Day History Stood Still: A Traveler’s Diary From Hiroshima
articles.summary: Standing in Hiroshima today left me truly speechless. I have visited many places in the course of my academic and professional life, from bustling capitals to quiet rural communities recovering from crisis, but standing in the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park this afternoon is an experience that sits quietly in my heart long after I walk […]
articles.hausa_translation: Ranar Tarihi ta Tsayawa: Littafin Makarantarwa na Mai Tafiya daga Hiroshima
critical_questions: What is the complete narrative being presented - does the article explore the historical context of the atomic bombing or focus primarily on emotional tourism?

Who is the author and what is their background - does their 'academic and professional life' bring specific expertise to analyzing Hiroshima's significance or are they presenting a personal travel memoir as historical analysis?
Why is this framed as 'history standing still' rather than examining how Hiroshima's legacy continues to shape contemporary geopolitics and nuclear policy debates?
What voices are missing - are hibakusha (survivors) and Japanese perspectives centered, or is this primarily a Western visitor's introspective account?

The service, however, has promised to reinstate applicants found to have been wrongly [&#82
